Alex (PM): Quick async pulse — Q2 OKR milestone check for cross-pillar work (autoscale + smart routing). Please drop: one-line status, owner, blocker if any. No novels, thx :sparkles:
Ben (Eng): Shipped core autoscale loop + rollout to staging. Owner: Ben. Blocker: perf regression on long sequences (investigating).
Charlie (Eng-ML): Model routing rules merged to canary. Owner: Charlie. Blocker: need more evals for fallback quality (2 failing prompts).
Dina (Eng-SRE): Observability dashboard ready, alert thresholds TBD. Owner: Dina. Blocker: need cost estimates from infra team to set thresholds.
Eva (Product Ops): Confirmed downstream product teams informed. Owner: Eva. Blocker: one dependent feature (embed cache) pushed by payments team — ETA Wed.
Frank (QA): Smoke tests green on staging. Owner: Frank. Blocker: intermittent tokenization mismatch on node v18.12 — reproducing.
Ben (Eng): Quick note: perf regression reproduces with sequences >8k. Mitigation idea: pin attention kernel to v2 for long runs. Will prototype today.
Charlie (Eng-ML): For the 2 failing prompts I added a small eval harness, PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/345. If anyone can run locally: `python eval/run_eval.py --prompts failing_set`
Dina (Eng-SRE): Can we delay full prod roll until the embed cache is in place? If not, we should enable canary traffic cap.
Alex (PM): Prefer conservative: hold full prod until embed cache live or enable canary cap. Can the cap be automated?
Dina (Eng-SRE): Yes — I can add rate cap and automatic rollback on error budget. ETA: 6h. Owner: Dina.
Eva (Product Ops): I'll update release notes and ping payments team. Owner: Eva.
Frank (QA): I'll add regression cases for tokenization mismatch. Owner: Frank.
Ben (Eng): Action: I'll prototype kernel pin and post results here by EOD. Owner: Ben.
Charlie (Eng-ML): Action: I'll run evals on canary and share summary. Owner: Charlie.
Alex (PM): Thanks — small recap for async folks: shipped -> staging autoscale + canary routing; slipped -> prod roll (blocked by embed cache + perf/regressions); owners listed above. Next sync in 24h unless blockers cleared. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment check: staging autoscale deployed at 2026-03-19T15:02:12Z, canary routing tag `canary-2026-03-19`.
Ben (Eng): noted deploy-bot. tagging breakfix PR: `fix/attention-longseq`
Dina (Eng-SRE): I'll post the canary cap config here when done.
Alex (PM): If you hit anything that will push ETA past Wed please update me directly. Thanks everyone.
